settings.question: How do I know which size to get?
settings.answer: Measure nose to base of tail while they're lying down, then add about 20cm. Between two sizes? Go up. Every bed's page lists the sleeping area, breeds and weight for each size, and the Bed Finder picks a size for you. Still unsure? Send us a photo of them asleep.

settings.question: What's inside, and isn't firmer better?
settings.answer: It depends on the bed, so each page says exactly what's inside: memory foam, egg-crate foam, crumb memory foam, fibre or mesh. Firmness is only how a bed feels on day one; what matters is whether it still holds them up a few winters on. Loose fibre packs down under a dog's weight. Foam keeps its shape far longer, which is why the memory foam beds carry a [years]-year guarantee on the core.

settings.question: What if my dog just won't use it?
settings.answer: Then it comes back. Some dogs claim a new bed the first night; some take a fortnight. Put it where they already sleep, with a blanket that smells of home on top. You've got [nights] nights. If it still isn't right, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund in full. Full terms are in our [returns_policy].

settings.question: When will it arrive, and what does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Our own stock is dispatched in [dispatch] working days, then standard delivery takes [transit] working days, free on orders over £[threshold] and £4.99 below. Express is £6.99. Every bed's page shows its dates before you order. A few beds ship from our partner warehouse and take longer; their pages say so.
